changelog: Added native encrypted DNS (DNS-over-HTTPS) and an optional HTTPS-Only Mode
New Security section in Settings showing what protections are active
Fixed target="_blank" links and window.open() popups never opening (a missing allowpopups attribute was silently blocking them)
Fixed the Google sign-in page being blocked by presenting a proper desktop browser identity
Fixed custom search engines that use a %s placeholder (e.g. Kagi) producing a broken, endlessly-retried URL
Fixed Auto-hide toolbar not reliably showing or staying hidden
Hid the scrollbar track on Settings and the setup wizard's theme step
